objective: Check the minimum tree leaf count over all pairs of fixed masks on small paths with exact closure and all visible affine queries.
status: Proved: The minima over both fixed masks and all adaptive visible affine queries are 2,2,4,4,6,6,8,8 leaves for one through eight path products. Exactly 92, 72 and 860 ordered five-product pairs require six, seven and eight leaves, and a six-product off-center split beats the literal midpoint six to eight.
title: Optimize visible XOR cases on small paths
